presentation.label: 1986 DIGITAL REVERB
presentation.summary: The Alesis Midiverb, Midiverb II and Midifex programs, run at their original arithmetic.
presentation.overview: Each program is the original unit's, played step for step: the same delay lines, the same 12-bit input, the same 16-bit memory and rounding, at half rate like the original. 174 programs in three banks; the name of each shows while you turn.
highlights: 174 original programs: 59 Midiverb, 56 Midiverb II, 59 Midifex
The original's grain: 12-bit input, 16-bit memory, its own rounding
Program and bank names in a message box as you turn
STOP, STOP, STOP cuts the tail; MIX 0 is exact dry
usage: Choose MIDIVRB I/II in FX2 SETUP: hold FUNC, press FX2, turn LEVEL to it and press YES, then press FX2 for the main page.
PROG (A) picks the program in the bank, BANK (D) switches between Midiverb, Midiverb II and Midifex; the message box names each.
LEVL (B) drives the 12-bit input: unity at 32, 64 is +6 dB. MIX (F): 0 dry, 127 wet only.
A new program starts from silence in under a tenth of a second; STOP, STOP, STOP cuts the tail until the track's next trig.

controls.name: PROG
controls.doc: the bank's program; its name shows in a message box while it turns

controls.name: LEVL
controls.doc: input level into the 12-bit converter: unity at 32, 64 is +6 dB

controls.name: BANK
controls.doc: Midiverb, Midiverb II or Midifex programs

controls.name: MIX
controls.doc: dry/wet; 0 is exact dry, 127 wet only

limitations: FX2 only: each instance uses the first 15,870 words of its track's 16K-word FX2 buffer and leaves the last 514 to Sidechain Compressor's key window on T3 and T7.
Patches one stock site of its own (0x4000d568), where each frame's parameters are final; Euclid's patch six bytes before returns into it, so both install together.

Up to 398 executed DSP instructions a sample in the emulator (declared 398), about 1.26 times stock SPRING REV at its worst (314). The 31 original programs that need more, and the Midiverb II's chorus and flange programs, are not in this release.

Unlike the original: 22.05 kHz instead of about 23.4 kHz (reverb times and delays about 6 % longer), no model of its analog filters and noise, some long delays up to 4.5 % shorter, and a mono input from the average of left and right.
On base 0.8.1, right after a pick the first NO only closes the memory box, and slow PROG and BANK turns do nothing until the FX2 page is entered again; base 0.8.2 fixes both.

access.location: Audio track FX2 SETUP: MIDIVRB I/II in the effect chooser.
steps: Select an audio track with its TRACK key.
Hold FUNC and press FX2 to open FX2 SETUP.
Turn LEVEL to MIDIVRB I/II and press YES to assign it.
Press FX2 for the main page: PROG, LEVL, BANK and MIX.
